unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 集中(注意力、精力等)于 `n.` 焦点，焦距
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You can't use your phone in class because you need to focus on learning.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法: 否克死(focus)，集中精力学习就不会挂科。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 雾，迷惘 `v.` 使困惑，使迷惘
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: you can't see much because of the heavy fog.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：青蛙 (frog) 在雾 (fog) 中迷路了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 折叠，包，对折，裹
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Glue or fold the paper.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: fo(谐音“佛”) + ld = 佛系折叠

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 传统民间的；民俗的 n. 民间音乐
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We enjoyed listening to traditional folk music around the campfire.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们在营火旁听着传统的民间音乐，感到非常享受。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：folk（民间、人们）里面藏着 f（飞）old（老），老百姓代代相传的民俗。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 喜欢的，喜欢，深情的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I have fond memories of my primary school teachers.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我对小学的老师们有着深厚美好的回忆。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：对食物很“疯”（fon）的“d”狗，说明它很“喜欢”吃东西。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 蠢人；傻瓜 v. 愚弄；欺骗
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Don't be a fool and trust strangers easily.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 别当傻瓜，轻易相信陌生人。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆：“福”气（foo）落（l）空，就变成了一个“傻瓜”。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 愚蠢的，傻的，出丑
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It was foolish of me to leave the door unlocked.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我没锁门，真是太糊涂/愚蠢了。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 构词法：fool（傻瓜）+ ish（像……的）= 愚蠢的，傻里傻气的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 足迹，脚印
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We found mysterious footprints in the snow.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们在雪地里发现了神秘的脚印。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词：foot（脚）+ print（印迹）= 脚印。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 禁止，不准，阻止
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The school rules forbid students to use phones in class.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 校规禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 构词法：for（否定前缀）+ bid（命令）= 命令不要做 = 禁止。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 预测，预报 v. 预测，预报
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 天气预报说明天会下雨。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 构词法：fore（在前，预先）+ cast（投掷）= 预先投射出去 = 预测。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 健忘的，疏忽的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I'm getting a little forgetful these days.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词缀法: forget (忘记) + ful (充满...的) -> 充满忘记的，意为健忘的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adv. 幸运地
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Fortunately, we missed the heavy traffic.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 幸运的是，我们避开了大堵车。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 构词法：fortune（运气）+ ate（形容词后缀）+ ly（副词后缀）= 幸运地。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 化石；老顽固，老古董
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Scientists discovered a dinosaur fossil in the desert.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 科学家在沙漠里发现了一块恐龙化石。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：fossil 听起来像“化石”的音译，或者记住它是埋在地下变成石头的遗迹。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 创建；创办(组织或机构)；建立(城镇或国家)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Talk about special days.
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: f (爸) + o + u + n + d -> 爸爸辛辛苦苦创立了公司。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 喷泉，喷水池，源泉
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Children love playing near the park fountain in summer.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 夏天孩子们喜欢在公园的喷泉旁玩耍。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：fount（泉水）+ in = fountain（喷泉）。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 淡水
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Dolphins usually live in the ocean, but some species live in freshwater.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 海豚通常生活在海洋里，但有些种类生活在淡水中。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词：fresh（新鲜的、淡的）+ water（水）= 淡水。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 可怕的，使人惊恐的，骇人的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Thunderstorms can be frightening for small children.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 雷雨对小孩子来说可能是可怕的。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 构词法：fright（惊恐）+ en（使……）+ ing（令人……的）= 令人惊恐的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 害怕的，惊吓的；使惊恐
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I didn't feel awkward or frightened at all.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：fright（害怕）+ en + ed = 惊吓的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 使沮丧，挫败，防止
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Repeated failures can frustrate even the hardest workers.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 接连的失败会使最勤奋的工人也感到沮丧。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：一事无成（free style）去撞（trate）墙，感到非常沮丧。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 燃料，刺激性言行 v. 增加，加油，给……提供燃料
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Wood and coal are common types of fuel.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 木头和煤是常见的燃料。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：汽车要跑，必须加“fuel”（福油 = 燃料）。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 葬礼，丧礼
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Many friends came to pay their last respects at the funeral.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 许多朋友来葬礼上表达最后的敬意。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：赴（fu）呢（ne）日（ral）之约去参加葬礼。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 家具
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They bought some new wooden furniture for their living room.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他们为客厅买了一些新的木制家具。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词缀记忆：fur（皮毛）+ niture（名词后缀，表集合）= 家具（注意是不可数名词）。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 星系；群英；人才荟萃
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Our solar system is located in the Milky Way galaxy.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们的太阳系位于银河系中。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词源记忆：来自希腊语 gala（奶），因为银河看起来像洒向天空的牛奶。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. (1) 画廊，美术馆；(2) 楼座；廊台；(3) 走廊
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We spent the afternoon viewing modern art at the local gallery.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们整个下午都在当地的美术馆欣赏现代艺术。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：歌（gal）里（lery）面都是艺术品，所以是画廊。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (`pl.` gases) 气体，气态；煤气，天然气
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: At least one well had some smelly gas coming out of it.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：gas（煤气/汽油），gas station是加油站。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 代沟 (教材常见义通常指“一代人”，此处按给定)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: There is often a communication gap between the older and younger generation.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 老一代和年轻一代之间往往存在沟通代沟。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：gene（基因）+ erate（产生）+ ion（名词后缀）= 同一代人/代沟。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 慷慨的；大方的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It was generous of him to donate money to the poor children.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他慷慨解囊向贫困儿童捐款，真是太大方了。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：gene（基因）很好、很贵气（ous）的人，通常都很慷慨。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 天才人物；天才
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Einstein was a scientific genius who changed our understanding of physics.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 爱因斯坦是一位改变了我们对物理学理解的科学天才。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：“极你死”（genius）——天才往往走在时代前端，思维极度烧脑。
